episodes.title: The Invitation
episodes.description: At an elite gala, a quiet figure in simple linen interrupts the powerful without raising his voice. An invitation leads away from hierarchy and into a circle of equal chairs, conversation and a shared fire.
beats: A lavish fictional elite gala hums with confident conversation.
Jesus arrives wearing plain linen. The room pauses.
He gently says, “Good evening.” A warm, disarming pause.
He smiles: “Don't let me interrupt. You seemed very busy.”
He approaches selected guests: “Come with me.”
The guests cross into a simple circular room with a central fire.
Everyone sits at equal height. “Well. How is everyone doing?”
Silence, reactions, small laughter. The real conversation begins.
episodes.notes: This is the established pilot concept and a provisional test storyboard, not an approved final screenplay. Dialogue examples are fictional written for the project.
